semiconductor_relevance: High — Tien Yu Co., Ltd. provides specialized electronic materials and distribution rights for semiconductor-related products, making it relevant in the semiconductor supply chain.
summary: Tien Yu Co., Ltd. specializes in the distribution of semiconductor electronic materials, including advanced packaging materials and components for various applications. The company focuses on providing marketing services for internationally recognized brands and aims to support the semiconductor and electronics industries with a comprehensive supply chain solution.
capabilities: Advanced packaging materials for CoWoS and AI applications
Specialized electronic materials for automotive electronics and LED optoelectronics
